note: Reference book profiles for the Step 0 engine decision (scripts/lib/engine-fit.js analyzeBookProfile). Agents fill a new book's profile by comparing it with these; scripts/test-engine-fit.js asserts each still yields `expect`. Add a row when a book's outcome (mute test / retention) teaches something.

rubric.world: real-historical = the book is ABOUT real events/people (biography, history, true crime, memoir) · period = invented story in a past world whose look matters (no fixed year: pre-1946 is normally period; 1946-1975 is decided by periodLook + ideaDensity, never by the year) · contemporary = invented story, roughly the last 70 years · speculative = sci-fi/fantasy/dystopia (an early year on a speculative book — a fantasy with a 1900 frame — is NOT period) · ideas = argument/advice/philosophy without a story world
rubric.realPeople: true only when specific real people/events are the SUBJECT. A novel with a real backdrop (WWII) = false + world period
rubric.format: story = told as a story · argument = ideas/advice/analysis · mixed = both carry the book
rubric.violence: central = the climax or most of mustSee is death/gore/violence · some = present, but the key images are not violent · none · harm to ANIMALS: see violenceOf + animalHarm
rubric.minorHarm: true when abuse/harm of a child is central to the book (policy: never depicted, photoreal excluded)
rubric.mustSee: 3-5 CONCRETE things the viewer must see for the summary to work (places, people, objects, events)
rubric.periodLook: essential = 2+ mustSee items are period places / dress / vehicles / technology / public events · backdrop = exactly 1 · none = the story could be told today. Required for a past world. The year alone never decides (2026-10-29).
rubric.ideaDensity: events = half or more of mustSee are physical events / places · ideas = half or more are inner states / ideas (period weight halves) · balanced. Required with periodLook.
rubric.animalHarm: with violenceOf animals: {role: main-conflict|subplot|backdrop, mustShow, weight: high|low} — central ONLY when main-conflict AND mustShow AND high; otherwise it counts as some (2026-10-29)
